Chocolate sweet with a sour kiss
Warm as sin but sharp as bliss
He holds me close, but counts the cost
Loving me like nothing’s lost 🍫✨

Chocolate skies hiding all our secret grins.
Throw another record on, let the vinyl spin,
CoffeeBreak's calling, let the day begin.

Every little moment tastes like destiny.

We're riding the coffee highway,
With glitter in our veins today.
Cherry horizons, cinnamon skies,
Dreaming with our wide awake eyes.

Pour another latte, sing it loud, sing proud,
We're painting pink thunder through every cloud.
One more heartbeat, one more rhyme,
CoffeeBreak forever, one cup at a time.

We'll be dancing in the kitchen to a homemade tune.
Bubblegum echoes floating through the air,
Love tastes sweeter when your favourite people are there.

Raise your mug higher, let the whole world know,
We're brewing up tomorrow wherever we go.

Kindness is the only fuel we'll ever need.

**Location:** [insert]

# ☕🔥 THE NARRATIVE ROASTER

### CoffeeBreak

**[Intro]**
“For You...”
Oh, I see the menu.
Narcissists.
Smear campaigns.
Dark secrets.
Guilty complexes.

Same coffee.
New thumbnail.
Let's roast it.

**[Verse 1]**
“There's a special place in hell”
That's quite a headline, can't you tell?
“Unpacking narcissism,” ring the bell
“Daddy issues” got another story to sell

“Forgiveness without control”
“Breaking the narcissist's narrative”
But who's controlling the narrative
When every cup gets served with another accusation?

**[Pre-Chorus]**
Deceptive tactics, guilty complex
Dark secret, what comes next?
Predator behind the halo
Everybody gets a label

**[Chorus]**
Flip that narrative, roast that roast
Who's telling stories and who's doing the most?
Smear campaign, guilty complex
Put your own words under the microscope next

“Narcissist!” “Narcissist!”
Echo through the room
Maybe all those thumbnails
Need a little breathing room

CoffeeBreak pouring truth into the cup
You can dress it up, but words still add up.

**[Verse 2]**
“Not a Lady,” “Predator,” “Behind the Halo”
That's a mighty lot of drama for one little video
“Malignant to her core”
“Whole life into a weapon”
Every new upload
Sounds like another confession

“Trapped in her own illusion”
“Self-hatred pretending to be insight”
“Anatomy of a smear campaign”
Now we're turning the camera toward the headline

**[Bridge]**
If you're breaking someone's narrative
Ask who wrote the script
If you're exposing deceptive tactics
Check every word that slipped

If forgiveness means letting go
Why keep feeding the flame?
If the story is really finished
Why keep repeating the name?

**[Breakdown]**
Narcissist.
Narrative.
Smear campaign.
Dark secret.

Say it once.
Say it twice.
Put it underneath the lights.

Now flip it.

Who benefits from the drama?
Who keeps pouring the coffee?
Who keeps pressing upload
When everybody else has gone home?

**[Final Chorus]**
Flip that narrative, roast that roast
Who's telling stories and who's doing the most?
“Guilty complex,” “deceptive tactics”
Maybe turn those words around and examine the practice

No threats.
No stalking.
No dirty little games.
Just CoffeeBreak with a microphone
Calling out the frame.
# ☕🔥 AT LEAST I HAVE TALENT

**[Verse]**
You can write another headline,
Put another label on the screen,
“Dark secret,” “guilty complex,”
You know what I mean.

Another “smear campaign,”
Another “narcissist” attack,
Another recycled narrative
Running on the same old track.

**[Pre-Chorus]**
You can talk about my name,
You can make another claim,
You can build another thumbnail
Trying to manufacture fame...

**[Chorus]**
But at least I have talent,
At least I can create,
At least when I open my mouth
There's something on the plate.

You can roast me in your videos,
You can make another attack,
But I've got songs in my bloodstream
And I keep coming back.

**At least I have talent,
At least I make art.
You can keep your narratives,
I've got music in my heart.**

**[Verse 2]**
“Not a lady,” “dark illusion,”
“Predator behind the halo,”
Every headline wants a villain,
Every story needs a label.

But here's my little plot twist,
No secret left to hide:

You can call it narcissism
You can call it a smear
But repeating someone's name
Doesn't make the story clear

**[Outro]**
CoffeeBreak closes the laptop. ☕

No more labels.
No more theatre.
No more recycled headlines.

Just one question:

**If you're exposing the narrative...
who keeps writing it?**

Strawberry and cream on your wrists like summer sugar,
soft cuffs of color, not restraint but play.
A coil of rope swings from an old tree branch,
frayed stories knotted into every twist.
Tree roots twist through quiet earth,
Holding stories older than words.
Rocks sit still, patient and wise,
Keeping time beneath open skies.
That’s a strong visual—very vintage glam. Here’s a polished pin-up style piece built from it:

Soft pink lips, a teasing smile,
Ringlets falling, styled just right—
A poster girl from another time,
Bathed in honeyed, golden light.

Flowing flowers trace her frame,
Petals drifting in the air,
Silk and satin whisper low,
Elegance without a care.

A glass of wine held just so,
Crimson catching candle glow,
Eyes that promise, eyes that play—
Half in shadow, half in day.

She’s charm and mischief intertwined,
A painted dream you can’t quite hold—
A fleeting glance, a perfect pose,
Soft and bold and quietly bold.
Love moves softer—like wind through leaves,
Unseen, but felt in what it weaves.
It grows like moss, slow and true,
Clinging to what it leans into.

Tree, rock, love—
All steady things.
Not loud, not rushed,
But lasting.
We don’t fight—
we dare each other instead.

Bare feet slap warm dirt,
laughter louder than the cicadas,
and then—
that leap.

Air rush,
a heartbeat pause,
the world held in a single bright second—

splash.

Cold water closes over everything,
sweetness dissolves,
and we come up grinning,
free, dripping,
alive.

Soft pink lips, a teasing smile,
Ringlets falling, styled just right—

Petals drifting in the air,

Soft and bold and quietly bold.
Love moves softer—like wind through leaves,

laughter louder than the cicadas,
and then—
that leap.

Air rush,
a heartbeat pause,
the world held in a single bright second—

splash.

sweetness dissolves,
and we come up grinning,
free, dripping,
alive.
